skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop the ability to reason logically and construct mathematical proofs.
Understand and apply concepts of sets, functions, and relations.
Design and analyze algorithms, including recursive algorithms.
Apply principles of counting, permutations, and combinations to solve problems.
Analyze and solve problems using graph theory concepts.
Understand and apply tree structures and their applications.
Apply mathematical concepts to solve practical problems such as shortest path, graph coloring, and minimum spanning tree.
Develop the ability to learn independently and work collaboratively.
Enhance critical thinking skills to analyze and solve complex problems.
Work effectively in groups and take responsibility for group tasks.
